section.heading: Rulemaking.

para.text: No later than the applicability date of the Medical Debt Mitigation Amendment Act of 2026, the Mayor, pursuant to subchapter I of Chapter 5 of Title 2, shall issue rules to implement the provisions of this subchapter, including:
Minimum requirements for patient appeals regarding their eligibility for financial assistance; and
The process for patients to submit a complaint to the Department pursuant to § 44-427(c).

The Department shall engage with health care facilities and patient advocates in the rulemaking process in order to minimize administrative costs for health care providers and ensure a streamlined application process for patients.

section.codify:annotation: Applicability of D.C. Law 26-172: § 6 of D.C. Law 26-172 provided that the creation of this section by § 2(c) of D.C. Law 26-172 is subject to the inclusion of the law’s fiscal effect in an approved budget and financial plan. Therefore that amendment has not been implemented.
